## Objective
Screen the unscaled features for biological interpretability and possible 
thresholds. All screenings were done in batch 1. 

###  Libraries and functions
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales) #allows pretty breaks on x axis
library(GGally) #pair plot matrix

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

parse_ai_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/parse_ai_features/")

explore_unscaled_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_unscaled/")

sub_name_translation <- c(
  villi_lp   = "Villi Lamina propria",
  crypts_lp  = "Crypts Lamina propria",
  villi_epi  = "Villi Epithelium",
  crypts_epi = "Crypts Epithelium"

# Custom renaming function: ONLY feature name
rename_features_only <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)  # Leave ID variable alone

    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clusters",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean\nsize",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD\nsize",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean\nlymphocyte\ndistance",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD\nlymphocyte\ndistance",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Junctional distance \\(median\\)") ~ "Median\njunctional\ndistance",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )
    feature
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
 
rename_custom_vars <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    # If not a 3-part name, return original
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)

    # Original components
    layer <- parts[1]
    compartment <- parts[2]
    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    # Abbreviate compartment
    compartment_abbr <- case_when(
      compartment == "Epithelium" ~ "Epi",
      compartment == "Lamina propria" ~ "LP",
      TRUE ~ compartment
    )

    # Custom feature name abbreviation
    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clust",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean size",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD size",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean lc dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD lc dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Junctional distance \\(median\\)") ~ "Median jun dist",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )

    paste0(feature, "\n", layer, " ", compartment_abbr)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

rename_raw_features <- function(feature_raw_vec) {
  sapply(feature_raw_vec, function(feature_raw) {
    case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epithelium-to-Lamina propria ratio",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clusters",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean size",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD size",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean lymphocyte distance",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD lymphocyte distance",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Junctional distance \\(median\\)") ~ "Median junctional distance",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}


plot_hist_density_stats <- function(.data,
                                    value_var,
                                    n_breaks = 9,         
                                    title_prefix = "",
                                    x_label = NULL,
                                    x_limits = NULL) {
  
  x_lab <- if (is.null(x_label)) value_var else x_label
  
  stats <- summarise(.data,
                     median_val = median(.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     q1        = quantile(.data[[ value_var ]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                     q3        = quantile(.data[[ value_var ]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                     mean_val  = mean(.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     sd_val    = sd  (.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
           mutate(iqr       = q3 - q1,
                  upper_2sd = mean_val + 2 * sd_val,
                  lower_2sd = mean_val - 2 * sd_val)

  ggplot(.data, aes(x = .data[[ value_var ]])) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30,
                   fill = "grey80", colour = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +

    # reference lines
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = median_val),  colour = "orange") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = q1),  colour = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = q3),  colour = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
   

    # nicer x-axis tick density
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +

    labs(title = title_prefix,
       x = x_lab,
       y = "Density") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) #+

    # summary text in the corner
    #geom_text(data = stats,
     #         aes(x = Inf, y = Inf,
      #            label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\n",
       #                          "q1 = ", round(q1, 2), "\n",
        #                        "q3 = ", round(q3, 2), "\n")),
         #    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 3)
}

break_long_labels <- function(name, cutoff1 = 15, cutoff2 = 30) {
  n <- nchar(name)
  
  if (n <= cutoff1) return(name)
  
  # Find all positions of space or hyphen
  matches <- gregexpr("[- ]", name)[[1]]
  
  if (n > cutoff2 && length(matches) >= 2 && matches[2] > 0) {
    # If > 40 chars, break at second match
    pos <- matches[2]
  } else if (length(matches) >= 1 && matches[1] > 0) {
    # Otherwise break at first match
    pos <- matches[1]
  } else {
    return(name)  # No space or dash found
  }
  
  paste0(
    substr(name, 1, pos - 1),
    "\n",
    substr(name, pos + 1, n)
  )
}

pairwise_correlations <- function(df) {
  
  break_long_labels <- function(name, cutoff1 = 20, cutoff2 = 40) {
    n <- nchar(name)
    if (n <= cutoff1) return(name)
    
    matches <- gregexpr("[- ]", name)[[1]]
    
    if (n > cutoff2 && length(matches) >= 2 && matches[2] > 0) {
      pos <- matches[2]
    } else if (length(matches) >= 1 && matches[1] > 0) {
      pos <- matches[1]
    } else {
      return(name)
    }
    
    paste0(substr(name, 1, pos - 1), "\n", substr(name, pos + 1, n))
  }
  
  df_clean <- if ("image_fragment_mucosa_name" %in% names(df)) {
    df %>% select(-image_fragment_mucosa_name)
  } else {
    df
  }
  
  colnames(df_clean) <- sapply(colnames(df_clean), break_long_labels)
  
  p <- GGally::ggpairs(
    df_clean,
    lower = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("points", alpha = .5, size = .6)),
    upper = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("cor", method = "spearman", digits = 2, size = 3)),
    diag  = list(continuous = "densityDiag")
  ) + 
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```


### Explore unscaled features batch 1
Features explored by compartment and layer. 

#### Issues/Deviations
- Distance to closest junction seems to correlate more with orientation then biology
- Epithelium-to-lamina propria ratio has high implausible outliers in crypts
- Some features were assessed prior to cleaning up script, assessments read in and added here to avoid 
redoing manual checks

#### Visual assessments of outliers
Separate templates for each layer/compartment combinations were printed,
uploaded to google sheets and assessed. For each new, the results from the
previous were loaded in, to avoid having to reassess non-mucosal segments. 
The separate google sheets, here:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18ZkYDUykvt_JNy2Gub1ktGOIhd2ny6Zd?usp=sharing

- **Epithelium/lamina propria ratio**
*Untrimmed range is 0.0006 to 2.5, (0.001 to 320 untransformed) in crypts and 0.0024 to 467 (0.001 - 2.67 log-transformed) in villi*
In crypts: 
  - > 0.65 (non-transformed 3.5) - always junk (not mucosa or poor ai performance with FP epithelium) 
  - 0.47 - 0.65 (2-3.5 non-transformed) colon or intususceptions with proliferative crypt epithelium
  - < 0.01 (0.02 non-transformed) all junk ( not si mucosa)
  - 0.01 - 0.07 (0.02 - 0.17 non-transformed) transmural lymphomas including large chunks of submucosa)
  - cutoff > 0.65 (3.5 nontransformed) (conservative)
  
In villi:
  - Everything above 30 is junk (27, log-transformed 1.45) - higher then for crypts  
  - Everything below 0.1 is junk (log-transformed 0.04, higher then crypts - infiltrate here does not obliterate epithelium in the same way)

- **Lymphocyte distance (mean)** 
In crypts lamina propria: Untrimmed range between 0 and 1.83 (log distance value max corresponds to 66.6 um)
  - >1.25 (corresponds to ~16.7 um) is either junk (non-si or poor ai performance in
  a LCL)
  - cutoff > 1.32 - corresponds to 20 um  (conservative)
In villi lamina propria: *Untrimmed range is 0.76 to 1.93* (corresponds to  4.8 to -84.1um untransformed)
  - everything > 1.32 corresponds to 20 um  is junk 
  
In epithelium: 
Values up to > 1.83 (66um can be accurate) (few are over that and are sorted by other threshold) - not useful as threshold

###  Process batch_1
Process batch 1 by subsetting biological improbabilities with threshold from above
```{r}
subset_name <- "batch_1"
unscaled  <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"))

unscaled_wide <- unscaled %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
    values_from = value
  )

biological_improbabilities_and_nas <- unscaled_wide %>%
  filter(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio` > 0.65 |
           `Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio` < 0.01 |
           `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)` > 1.32 |
           `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)` > 1.32 |
           !complete.cases(.))

filtered_unscaled <- unscaled_wide %>%
  filter(!image_fragment_mucosa_name %in% biological_improbabilities_and_nas$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "scaled_", subset_name, ".json"))
scaled_wide <- scaled  %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
    values_from = scaled
  )
filtered_scaled <- scaled_wide %>%
  filter(!image_fragment_mucosa_name %in% biological_improbabilities_and_nas$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

write_json(biological_improbabilities_and_nas, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "improbabilities_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_unscaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_scaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)          
### Plot distributions of filtered values
filtered_unscaled_var <- setdiff(names(filtered_unscaled), "image_fragment_mucosa_name")

for (var in filtered_unscaled_var) {

  # Split variable name into parts
  parts <- strsplit(var, "_")[[1]]
  
  # Handle potential 3+ part variable names (some features have underscores)
  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    layer <- parts[1]
    compartment <- parts[2]
    feature <- paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_")  
  } else {
    layer <- compartment <- feature <- var
  }

  # Construct title and x-axis label
  title_prefix <- paste(layer, compartment, sep = " - ")
  x_axis_label <- feature

  # Plot and save
  p <- plot_hist_density_stats(
  .data = filtered_unscaled,
  value_var = var,
  title_prefix = title_prefix,
  x_label = x_axis_label)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, var, "_", subset_name, "_filtered.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 3.5,
    height = 1.7,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )
}

```

### Check pairwise correlations (by layer and compartment) for scaled -  batch 1
#### Issues/Deviations
Pairwise correlations for epi/lp ratio did not print with this loop (because only in lp). Adjusted the code to print the plot in th console.
```{r}
subset_name <- "batch_1"
explore_unscaled_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_unscaled/")

cluster_prep_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/cluster_prep/")

filtered_scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_", subset_name, ".json")) 

# Define base ID
id_col <- "image_fragment_mucosa_name"

# Get all column names
all_vars <- names(filtered_scaled)

# Define filtering patterns for each group
group_patterns <- list(
  villi_lp   = "Villi_Lamina propria_",
  crypts_lp  = "Crypts_Lamina propria_",
  villi_epi  = "Villi_Epithelium_",
  crypts_epi = "Crypts_Epithelium_"
)

# Create a list to hold split dataframes
split_frames <- list()

# Loop over each pattern
for (group in names(group_patterns)) {
  pattern <- group_patterns[[group]]
  
  selected_vars <- all_vars[grepl(paste0("^", pattern), all_vars)]
  df_group <- filtered_scaled %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(selected_vars)) %>%
    rename_with(rename_features_only, .cols = all_of(selected_vars))
  
  split_frames[[group]] <- df_group
}

sub_names <- names(split_frames)

for (sub_name in sub_names){
  df <- split_frames[[sub_name]]
  
  tit <- sub_name_translation[[sub_name]]
  
  pairwise_plot <- pairwise_correlations(df) + ggtitle(tit)
  
  ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, sub_name,"_pairs_", subset_name, ".png")),
  plot     = pairwise_plot,
  width    = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300
)
  
  
}

# Define compartments and abbreviations
compartments <- c("Villi_Lamina propria_", "Crypts_Lamina propria_", 
                  "Villi_Epithelium_", "Crypts_Epithelium_")

compartment_abbr <- c("Villi LP", "Crypts LP", "Villi Epi", "Crypts Epi")

# Extract unique features
feature_vars <- setdiff(names(filtered_scaled), "image_fragment_mucosa_name")
unique_features <- feature_vars %>%
  str_replace("^(Villi|Crypts)_(Epithelium|Lamina propria)_", "") %>%
  unique()

# Loop over each feature
for (feature in unique_features) {
  
  # Explicitly build column names to select
  feature_cols <- paste0(compartments, feature)
  
  # Check columns exist to avoid select() error
  missing_cols <- setdiff(feature_cols, names(filtered_scaled))
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0){
    warning(paste("Skipping feature due to missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    next
  }
  
  df_feature <- filtered_scaled %>% 
    select("image_fragment_mucosa_name", all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Rename columns clearly
  colnames(df_feature) <- c(
    "image_fragment_mucosa_name",
    paste(compartment_abbr)
  )
  
  tit <- rename_raw_features(feature)

  # Generate the correlation plot (excluding ID column)
  pairwise_plot <- pairwise_correlations(df_feature %>% select(-image_fragment_mucosa_name)) +
    ggtitle(tit) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
  
  # Save plot
  safe_feature_name <- str_replace_all(feature, "[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(explore_unscaled_dir, paste0("cross_compartment_", safe_feature_name, "_", subset_name, ".png")),
    plot     = pairwise_plot,
    width    = 7, height = 6.8, units = "in", dpi = 300
  )
}



```

```{r}
filtered_scaled <- scaled_wide %>%
  filter(!image_fragment_mucosa_name %in% biological_improbabilities_and_nas$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

write_json(biological_improbabilities_and_nas, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "improbabilities_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_unscaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_scaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)          
### Plot distributions of filtered values
filtered_unscaled_var <- setdiff(names(filtered_unscaled), c("image_fragment_mucosa_name", "image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name"))

#Create a table with which variables I have for each feature
feature_map <- filtered_unscaled_var |>
  setNames(filtered_unscaled_var) |>
  lapply(function(var) {
    parts <- strsplit(var, "_")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) >= 3) {
      paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_")
    } else {
      var
    }
  }) |>
  stack() |>
  rename(feature = values, var = ind)

# Compute global x-lims for each featue (to keep x-axis the same between compartments/layers)
feature_limits <- feature_map |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    min_val = min(sapply(var, function(v) min(filtered_unscaled[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))),
    max_val = max(sapply(var, function(v) max(filtered_unscaled[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  )

feature_x_labels <- c(
  "Count" = "Count per 1000 µm²",
  "% in clusters" = "% in clusters",
  "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" = "Log-transformed Epithelium-to-Lamina propria ratio",
  "Lymphocyte distance (mean)" = "Mean log-transformed lymphocyte distance (µm)",
  "Lymphocyte distance (sd)"   = "SD of log-transformed lymphocyte distance (µm)",
  "Size (mean)" = "Mean nuclear area (µm²)",
  "Size (sd)"   = "SD of nuclear area (µm²)",
  "Junctional distance (median)" = "Median log-transformed junctional distance (um)"
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(feature_map))) {
  var <- feature_map$var[i]
  feature <- feature_map$feature[i]

  # 🧼 Ensure var is character (fixes the .data[[ value_var ]] error)
  value_var <- as.character(var)

  # Split into parts
  parts <- strsplit(value_var, "_")[[1]]
  layer <- parts[1]
  compartment <- parts[2]
  x_axis_label <- feature_x_labels[[feature]]
  title_prefix <- paste(layer, compartment, sep = " - ")

  # Get limits for this feature
  xlim_vals <- feature_limits |>
    filter(feature == !!feature) |>
    select(min_val, max_val) |>
    unlist()

  # Plot
  p <- plot_hist_density_stats(
    .data = filtered_unscaled,
    value_var = value_var,
    title_prefix = title_prefix,
    x_label = x_axis_label,
    x_limits = xlim_vals
  )

  # Save
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, value_var, "_", subset_name, "_filtered.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 3.5,
    height = 1.7,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
subset_name <- "full"
unscaled  <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"))

unscaled_wide <- unscaled %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
    values_from = value
  )

biological_improbabilities_and_nas <- unscaled_wide %>%
  filter(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio` > 0.65 |
           `Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio` < 0.01 |
           `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)` > 1.32 |
           `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)` > 1.32 |
           !complete.cases(.))

filtered_unscaled <- unscaled_wide %>%
  filter(!image_fragment_mucosa_name %in% biological_improbabilities_and_nas$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "scaled_", subset_name, ".json"))
scaled_wide <- scaled  %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
    values_from = scaled
  )
filtered_scaled <- scaled_wide %>%
  filter(!image_fragment_mucosa_name %in% biological_improbabilities_and_nas$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

write_json(biological_improbabilities_and_nas, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "improbabilities_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_unscaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)

write_json(filtered_scaled, paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty=TRUE)          
### Plot distributions of filtered values
filtered_unscaled_var <- setdiff(names(filtered_unscaled), c("image_fragment_mucosa_name", "image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name"))


 # Get unique features
 feature_limits <- list()
 
 # find all features and their corresponding variable names
 feature_map <- lapply(filtered_unscaled_var, function(var) {
   parts <- strsplit(var, "_")[[1]]
   feature <- if (length(parts) >= 3) paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_") else var
   list(feature = feature, var = var)
 }) |> bind_rows()
 
 # For each feature, calculate global range
 for (f in unique(feature_map$feature)) {
   vars_in_feature <- feature_map |> filter(feature == f) |> pull(var)
   all_values <- unlist(lapply(vars_in_feature, function(v) filtered_unscaled[[v]]))
   feature_limits[[f]] <- range(all_values, na.rm = TRUE)
 }
 
 
 for (var in filtered_unscaled_var) {
 
   # Split variable name into parts
   parts <- strsplit(var, "_")[[1]]
   
   # Handle potential 3+ part variable names (some features have underscores)
   if (length(parts) >= 3) {
     layer <- parts[1]
     compartment <- parts[2]
     feature <- paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_")  
   } else {
     layer <- compartment <- feature <- var
   }
 
   # Construct title and x-axis label
   title_prefix <- paste(layer, compartment, sep = " - ")
   x_axis_label <- feature
 
   x_limits <- feature_limits[[feature]]
   
   # Plot and save
   p <- plot_hist_density_stats(
   .data = filtered_unscaled,
   value_var = var,
   title_prefix = title_prefix,
   x_label = x_axis_label,
   x_limits = x_limits) +
     ggtitle(NULL)
 
   ggsave(
     filename = paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, var, "_", subset_name, "_filtered.png"),
     plot = p,
     width = 2.25,
     height = 0.85,
     units = "in",
    dpi = 300
   )
 }
 
 split_vars <- lapply(image_fragment_mucosa_names, function(x) {
   parts <- strsplit(x, "_")[[1]]
   n <- length(parts)
   list(
     image_name = paste(parts[1:(n - 2)], collapse = "_"),
     fragment_name = parts[n - 1],
     mucosa_name = parts[n]
   )
 })
 
 summary_table <- filtered_unscaled %>%
  select(-image_fragment_mucosa_name, -image_name, -fragment_name, -mucosa_name) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    list(
      median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
       q1     = ~ quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      q3     = ~ quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      iqr    = ~ IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  ))
```
